message:
As Solar Energy Systems Engineer, Manager, solar-only means the grown split array must cover every watt-hour with no grid help.

In plain words the sun must meet a household-size day while the panels stay unshaded and cool, Enclosure and Structural Designer. I take up the module datasheet in PRBS 400W Monocrystalline Photovoltaic Panels | Commercial & High-Performance (E64) that you put on the board, which lists 1722 by 1134 mm and about 20.5 kg, confirming nine modules cover 17.6 square metres in the nine-module footprint calc (E84), about a parking space against a 4.32 square metre roof, so 2 modules stay on the roof gantry as sunshade with vent gap plus 7 modules on a separate ground frame with zero shading 9am-3pm, equator-facing tilt equal latitude plus 10 degrees, and worst-month 5.0 Peak Sun Hours (PSH, hours at 1000 watt per square metre) in my assumed constraint. Daily yield 13.5 kilowatt-hour per day in the grown-array yield calc (E83) covers daily load 13.2 kilowatt-hour per day in the steady plus staged pull-down estimate (E58) with margin 0.300 kilowatt-hour per day in the daily margin calc (E86), about one household daily use so everyday scale holds. Photovoltaic means PV, solar electricity.

In plain words batteries run wires at night while ice runs cold at night, Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer. The 48 volt Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4, lithium battery chemistry) bank with Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT, solar optimizer) must output dispatchable electricity for compressor start plus fans and controls, while the daytime Phase-Change Material (PCM, ice store) thermal battery of 100 to 150 kg ice carries night cold to cut cycling, mapped from storing water by day in a tank for night use in Solar Water Pumps, DC Pumps, Solar Well Pumps | NAZ Solar Electric (E79). That tradeoff keeps direct-drive daylight cooling plus electrochemical cover for cloud and night within that same daily balance.

In plain words cleaning and terminals protect the balance more than extra panels, Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist. I take up the door rule in Coolroom Buying Guide: Walk-In Refrigeration for Kitchens (E71) that you put on the board, which states 900 mm doors with Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC, flexible plastic) strip curtains, which from my side keeps door loss to only 0.44 kilowatt-hour per day in the door infiltration estimate (E57), about a kettle boiled twice, inside the 13.5 kilowatt-hour yield. The guidance in 48V Lithium Battery Maintenance Guide: How To Extend Your Solar Battery Lifespan And Improve Performance (E80) gives 10 to 15 years with monthly wipe and terminal checks, so the vented locked battery box plus wiped panels is attendant work funded by the crate fee.

I am ready on version one, because yield covers staged load with small margin, split 2 plus 7 avoids roof loads and shading, battery plus ice covers night wires and cold, and maintenance is attendant-doable with only the 43 degree pull-down bench test left as named hardware test.
